title: idc365-decisions configuration
description: The merged content of every config/*.yaml file in the documentation repository. Each top-level key may appear in only one file.

categories.description: Category lists per type: a map from category name to its human description and AI `when`.

attachment_types.description: Allowed attachment file extensions (lowercase, without dot) mapped to their media type.

attachment_max_bytes.description: Maximum size of one attachment binary in bytes.

repositories.description: Code repositories that may have shadow documents, as org/repo.

jira_base_url.description: Base URL a Jira key is appended to, ending with a slash, for example https://example.atlassian.net/browse/. null while not configured.

priming_budget.description: Maximum characters of SessionStart priming: fixed text plus the bodies of all featured documents.

cooldown_days.description: Minimum age in days of a package version before it may be used.

when.description: AI-facing: when a document belongs in this category.
